title: Dante Vale's motorbike
summary: Dante Vale's motorbike is a burgundy motorbike used by Dante Vale. It is unclear whether Dante owns the bike or rented it.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
After achieving his solo mission in [[:Category:Baja California, Mexico|Baja California]], [[Dante Vale]] asked the rest of the team to join him. While waiting for them at the airport on a bike, he witnessed a bunch of [[Suits]] ambushing the Huntik team's [[Huntik Foundation's cargo jet|cargo jet]] with their own [[The Organization's motorbikes|bikes]], and chased them down. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

full_text:
Dante Vale's motorbike is a burgundy motorbike used by Dante Vale. It is unclear whether Dante owns the bike or rented it.

==History==
After achieving his solo mission in Baja California, Dante Vale asked the rest of the team to join him. While waiting for them at the airport on a bike, he witnessed a bunch of Suits ambushing the Huntik team's cargo jet with their own bikes, and chased them down. [The Power of Umbra]
